BL-620 — Front desk reads photo captions (text ?? caption) and logs a one-line reason for every dropped update
Approval context: One recommendation to veto cheaply: caption-only routing with an image-not-read annotation (no vision, no image storage), plus a distinct visible drop reason for captionless media. If you want captionless photos to do anything smarter than a logged refusal, say so and it becomes its own ticket. Fir…
BL-620 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-620" (or "reject BL-620 <reason>") to act.
